A [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] world, '''Orin''' occupied the second-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] position within the [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet had an elliptical [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], passing through the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] of the nearby [[Velser's Ring/Legends|Velser's Ring]] twice during its [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. The planet's black surface was rocked by frequent [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] and covered with rivers of lava and erupting [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]]. Orin's surface temperature was unbearably high and its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was choked with thick soot and ash that rained down from the sky.
